messages:
Priya (CS): Quick capture from CardioPath onboarding call — procurement stalled signing MSA because they can't reconcile route-level charges and need export audit keys. Putting raw asks here for product triage.
Priya (CS): Raw asks from customer (verbatim):
- "We need per-route line items + a stable export_id on every CSV export for our GL mapping."
- "Transcript export must include session_tags and a backfill for last 90 days."
- "An onboarding checklist / SDK sample to map embedding calls to internal cost centers would help our Finance and Platform teams."
- "Long clinical templates sometimes end mid-sentence; this is causing compliance notes to be incomplete."
Liam (PM): Thanks. Can you add severity and whether a short-term manual workaround exists? That will help prioritization for release planning.
Priya (CS): Severity/impact estimates: billing CSV = critical (blocks MSA/renewal), export_id/backfill = high, SDK mapping sample = medium (enablement), template truncation = medium-high (affects compliance). Manual workaround: we can provide a reconciled CSV and a manual backfill for 90d exports.
Rosa (Eng): Technical note: exporter service uses export-schema v2. Adding `export_id` and `route_id` columns is straightforward. Backfill will be a scheduled job but doable in ~2d depending on data volume.
Rosa (Eng): Quick CSV schema suggestion:
```
csv_columns = ["export_id","export_timestamp","route_id","session_tag","user_id","tokens","charge_usd"]
```
Nate (AM): Procurement said they need a signed sample before Friday. If we can ship a one-off reconciled CSV today, they might proceed with signatures.
Liam (PM): Ok label: per-route export + export_id = P0. Backfill job = P1. SDK sample = P2. Template truncation investigation = P1. Can engineering estimate effort in next 6h?
Rosa (Eng): I can spike the schema change and produce a manual reconciled CSV from staging today (ETA 3h) if Priya uploads the sample export. Backfill PR ETA 2d.
Priya (CS): Uploading sample export now and attaching the procurement email. Also capture the customer quote for exec review.
Priya (CS): Customer quote to attach: "Without route-level exports and a stable export key we cannot map any charge to our GL. This is a hard stop for procurement."
sdk-bot: Created tasks CP-5010 (add-export-id-route-columns), CP-5011 (export-backfill-90d), CP-5012 (sdk-cost-mapping-sample), CP-5013 (template-length-regression) and linked to workspace "CardioPath-Onboard". CP-5010 flagged P0.
Liam (PM): Owners? Rosa take CP-5010 + CP-5011. Priya will own CP-5012 (enablement sample) and procurement comms. I'll own CP-5013 and coordinate test vectors.
Rosa (Eng): Confirmed. Opening PR for CP-5010 now. Small migration to backfill export_id required; will add migration notes.
Priya (CS): Short-term ask: can we provide a CSV with per-route totals + a checksum and `export_id` today? Procurement will accept that as an interim audit artifact.
Rosa (Eng): Yes, generating manual reconciled CSV from staging ETA 3h. Will include `export_id` as sha256(export_timestamp + job_id) for stability.
Liam (PM): Please include a minimal `README.md` with the manual CSV describing fields and mapping rules for Finance. Priya, attach that to procurement thread.
Priya (CS): Will do. Also adding renewal-risk = high on the account until we confirm procurement sign-off. Scheduling a follow-up demo with procurement tomorrow 9am PT.
Nate (AM): I'll be on the demo. If we get the manual CSV today, I'll push for signature.
Liam (PM): Good. We'll review CP-5010 PR in tomorrow triage and decide if CP-5011 gets sprint allocation. Thanks all :thumbsup:
